Chapter 1283: 32: Is This An Avatar?

Chapter 1283: Chapter 32: Is This an Avatar?

Galactic Sage.

More than ten Supreme Sages couldn’t help but shudder at these four words.

Galactic Sage?

The contemporary Invincible Sage, the Galactic Sage?

The Galactic Sage should belong to the type of Great Sage who emerged out of nowhere, having made few appearances before demonstrating the power of an Invincible Sage.

However, the Galactic Sage became an Invincible Sage who dominated the Chaos Void through just one brief battle.

That battle made many Supreme Sages not even dare to have the thought of competing with the Galactic Sage.

Outside the Galactic Chaos Continent, two Supreme Sages jointly descended.

But in front of the Galactic Sage, they couldn’t even resist and dissipated instantly?

Who could withstand such a method?

With the end of that crushing battle, more and more information was released.

For instance, it wasn’t just two Supreme Sages involved but also an imprint of the ‘Luo Hou Great Sage’.

Luo Hou Great Sage was a long-renowned Supreme Sage, allegedly having mastered a certain thirteenth-level legacy.

He possessed the power of a conventional Invincible Sage.

Yet in front of the Galactic Sage, he also melted like snow.

This is simply unimaginable.

There’s also another rumor.

Originally, Luo Hou Great Sage planned to sweep through the Chaos Void to prove the name ‘Invincible’.

But because of Lin Yuan’s intervention, this idea was completely extinguished, leading him to directly pursue the thirteenth level.

“Galactic Sage, could Myriad Laws actually invite the Galactic Sage?”

A Supreme Sage couldn’t help but say.

Since that battle, countless powerhouses have visited the Galactic Sage.

Chaos Great Sage? Supreme Sage? Even unique entities like the Eye of Myriad Laws.

However.

The Galactic Sage seemed very reluctant to engage with unique entities, never having met any visiting unique entity.

With the Galactic Sage’s power, since he did not wish to meet them, those unique entities had no choice but to quietly leave.

These unique entities cannot directly intervene; this is a rule set by the life of time, so they are very humble when facing Supreme Sages sweeping through the Chaos Void.

Moreover, these unique entities see much further and deeper than Supreme Sages and deduced that Lin Yuan is not just an Invincible Sage but the strongest Invincible Sage born from the Chaos Void.

With such power, unless the unique entities are crazy, they naturally dare not provoke him.

“Myriad Laws has his own methods.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu didn’t know how the Eye of Myriad Laws managed to invite the Galactic Sage.

But since the Eye of Myriad Laws told him so, he must have truly invited him.

“However…”

Great Saint Feng Zhu thought for a moment and continued, “Myriad Laws said the Galactic Sage only sent an avatar.”

An avatar?

Many Supreme Sages were slightly taken aback.

No matter how much they admired the Galactic Sage’s power, it was just an avatar?

The Invincible Sage ultimately remains at the twelfth level, so how strong could a casually conjured avatar be?

It might not even be comparable to a Supreme Sage.

No matter how strong the Galactic Sage is, sending just an avatar to retrieve the Source Fruit within three days, isn’t that a bit arrogant?

“Since the Galactic Sage does so, he must have assurance.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu looked at all the Supreme Sages and spoke.

He also found it incredible when he first heard this news.

But on second thought, given the Galactic Sage’s level, there must be his considerations.

It’s not something they, as Supreme Sages, can grasp.

Since the Galactic Sage acts in this manner, he must be confident.

And with the Galactic Sage’s status, since he agreed to help the Eye of Myriad Laws, how could he handle it lightly? If he was unwilling, he could just refuse.

“Indeed.”

Many Supreme Sages suddenly realized.

Thinking it over, they agreed with this notion.

“I speculate that the Galactic Sage sent only an avatar to first check the depths outside the Dimensional Rift, and once he confirms there is no threat, his true form will descend to sweep in and retrieve the Source Fruit.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu shared his speculation.

The Dimensional Rift is fraught with danger, even the Invincible Sage cannot guarantee a safe retreat.

The Galactic Sage is prudent, first sending an avatar to the rift to ensure there’s no problem before deploying his true form, which is foolproof.

Once these words were spoken.

The other Supreme Sages nodded repeatedly.

Indeed.

This explanation made perfect sense.

“With the Galactic Sage’s intervention, there is a great chance of retrieving the Source Fruit within three days.”

The Supreme Sages wore smiles on their faces.

They were invited by the Eye of Myriad Laws, partly as a favor, but if they manage to retrieve the Source Fruit successfully, the Eye of Myriad Laws would surely offer more rewards.

At the level of Supreme Sage, most of Chaos Void’s rare treasures hold little use.

But the precious rewards offered by the Eye of Myriad Laws are definitely satisfactory for the Supreme Sages.

“This time, we can witness the means of the Galactic Sage’s true form.”

A Supreme Sage was filled with anticipation; among all the Invincible Sages born in the history of the Chaos Void, the Galactic Sage was undoubtedly the most mysterious, and even he had rarely showcased his power.

Suddenly.

At this moment.

The Power of Space-Time gathered, forming a figure not far from the dozen Supreme Sages.

“Is the Galactic Sage here?”

The Supreme Sages were excited, all turning toward that figure.

The figure was a young man, with both hands behind his back, a faint Yin-Yang Taiji mark spinning between his brows.

“Is this just an avatar of the Galactic Sage?”

A Supreme Sage was shocked, for even just an avatar gave them immense pressure, a pressure stemming from his grasp of space-time.

“As expected of the Galactic Sage.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu marveled inwardly, realizing he had underestimated the Galactic Sage’s power.

With his perception, he felt that even he might not be able to defeat this avatar standing before him.

In other words, a single avatar of the Galactic Saint is comparable to an Absolute Saint? This kind of existence likely hasn’t appeared in the history of the Chaos Void.

“Is this the dimensional rift?”

Lin Yuan took a step forward, appearing before more than a dozen Absolute Saints, and casually said.

“Yes.”

“The Magic Origin Fruit that Myriad Laws desires is on the small continent outside the rift…”

Great Saint Feng Zhu’s heart tightened, and he immediately gave an overview of the situation.

He particularly emphasized the dimensional beings born on that small continent outside the rift. These beings are inherently powerful, instinctually affecting space and time, and combined with fighting on home ground, even an Absolute Saint finds it tricky to face a large group of them, not daring to confront them head-on.

“Galactic Saint, our main battle bodies are inside. We can join forces then…”

Great Saint Feng Zhu quickly said.

The main battle bodies of more than a dozen Absolute Saints are now on that small continent.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Once again, he took a step forward.

Entering the dimensional rift.

…

In another location.

The Eye of Myriad Laws also observed the dimensional rift from afar.

“The incarnation of the Galaxy has arrived? Such speed, was it nearby?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked towards Lin Yuan’s incarnation.

“I didn’t expect that now, I can’t even gauge the depth of the Galaxy’s avatar.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws shook his head.

A long time ago, he couldn’t perceive Lin Yuan’s true form.

Now, he couldn’t even see through the avatar.

In the vision of the Eye of Myriad Laws, even if it’s just an avatar of Lin Yuan, it influences the surrounding Spacetime Great Dao like a black hole.

“That little guy from back then has grown to this point.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws was equally amazed. When he first met Lin Yuan, the latter wasn’t even in the Chaos Realm.

…

Most regions of the dimensional gap are dim and dark.

After Lin Yuan’s avatar entered the dimensional rift, he quickly saw the small continent nurturing the Magic Origin Fruit.

The continent was only as large as a Void Domain, but because it was detached from the Chaos Void environment, within the dimensional gap, it was difficult to utilize any Dao rules or overcome some inexplicable suppression, making it challenging even for an Absolute Saint to instantaneously traverse the continent to retrieve that Magic Origin Fruit.

“Galactic Saint.”

“Galactic Saint.”

The main battle bodies of the Absolute Saints immediately approached.

“Galactic Saint, the Magic Origin Fruit is there.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu said, and Lin Yuan looked in the direction. He saw a tree swaying in the depths of the small continent.

The tree appeared dark, with vague undulations of Dao rules, and a fist-sized fruit hung from the branches.

“Magic Origin Fruit.”

Lin Yuan understood.

Because the Magic Origin Fruit absorbs the laws and principles of different dimensional spaces, it is very useful for the Eye of Myriad Laws, which is based on the path of roads.

The so-called laws and principles are the evolutionary path breaths of different dimensional spaces.

“Galactic Saint, the closer you get to the Magic Origin Fruit, the more numerous those dimensional beings become. Currently, we are only on the periphery.” Great Saint Feng Zhu explained.

Lin Yuan also observed those indigenous dimensional beings on the small continent.

In fact, during his previous travels in the Boundless Void, Lin Yuan had also encountered these dimensional beings. However, those beings were incredibly weak, having been captured into the Void Secret Realm of the Boundless Void, hence they were also called Void Creatures.

“It’s manageable.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

After only a few glances, Lin Yuan roughly discerned the strength of these dimensional beings.

Indeed, they are very strong.

Even a regular Invincible Great Saint would have difficulty forcibly retrieving the Magic Origin Fruit from so many dimensional beings within three days.

“Galactic Saint, what should we do now?”

Great Saint Feng Zhu asked.

The remaining dozen Absolute Saints obediently followed orders.

Originally, this group of Absolute Saints was led by Great Saint Feng Zhu.

But with the arrival of the Galactic Saint, everything naturally followed his lead.

“You don’t need to do anything.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the many Absolute Saints and casually said, “I’ll take action myself and just retrieve the Magic Origin Fruit directly.”

“Alright.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu was shocked, but considering the power of the Galactic Saint, he chose to believe him.

“When will the true form of the Galactic Saint descend?”

Great Saint Feng Zhu inquired.

The other Absolute Saints were filled with excitement.

They also wanted to see the true form of the Galactic Saint descend, suppress these indigenous dimensional beings, and ultimately retrieve the Magic Origin Fruit.

“True form?”

Lin Yuan smiled and said, “That’s not necessary.”

In the next moment.

Under the incredulous gaze of more than a dozen Absolute Saints.

Lin Yuan extended his hand.

Whoosh!

The palm was vast, like the falling sky, reaching towards the deepest part of the small continent.

During this, the indigenous dimensional beings rose to challenge the sky-covering hand, roaring, but were ultimately silently annihilated.

In merely an instant, the small tree bearing the Magic Origin Fruit, along with its large rooted area of land, was grasped by the enormous hand and brought before Lin Yuan.

“Done.”

Lin Yuan looked at the tree with the Magic Origin Fruit in his hand and smiled.

The dozen Absolute Saints felt their minds turning to mush as they watched Lin Yuan smilingly examine the Magic Origin Fruit tree in his hand.

A thought involuntarily arose in their minds.

Is this really just an avatar?
